description: Source code for a wizard in an Odoo (OpenERP) module handling partial stock picking operations, including packing, splitting, and backorder management.

classes.name: partial_picking
classes.description: Wizard interface class for handling partial stock picking operations, including move retrieval, splitting, and default data setup.

methods.name: make_default
methods.description: Creates a default value function for form fields.

methods.name: _to_xml
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for XML compatibility.

methods.name: _get_moves
methods.description: Retrieves move lines for a given picking and prepares XML form data.

methods.name: _do_split
methods.description: Splits stock moves into new pickings based on user input, updating prices and quantities.

methods.name: _get_default
methods.description: Sets default back order notification message if a back order exists.
